Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: first project reached day 1 and he replied positively (email:c68d2841), but said "all good" and deferred a call, with no invites sent 6 days in despite two nudges (email:cf0d4645, email:e8eeaef3). Solo passive use suggests moderate, not high, odds of hitting the milestone unaided in 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the note — glad things are running smoothly with your first project in Wrenfield.

On the walkthrough: would a short call this week work? I can look at how your project is structured and answer anything about getting the rest of your team in. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a quick look is usually enough.

Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Best,
Nadia
